note: All preceding bytes become the filter string, allowing crafted expressions that stress the optimizer.
The filter text is parsed into a BPF IR graph for later optimization.
The parsed graph is sent to the optimizer, which is the component implicated by the crash report.
The optimizer allocates heap state for the CFG and stores pointers that later must be torn down safely.

note: Allocation failures in the optimizer explicitly free several heap objects before longjmp-based unwinding, so a second cleanup pass would double-free them.
If an opt_error is raised after partial cleanup, this handler runs and frees the optimizer state again during unwinding.
